newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace down on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc fell for a third day on Thursday as the stock continued to attract profit-taking after its recent strong run, traders and analysts said.

The stock was down 16p at 1146-1/2 by 1025 GMT, on top of a 27p drop in the previous two sessions. "As far as we are aware it is just profit-taking, there are no new negative stories," said one analyst.

BAE reached a record close of 11.88-1/2 stg on October 21, after a surge from around 890p at the start of June -- powered by a mix of positive factors ranging from hopes for restructuring in the European aerospace industry to last month's buoyant results.
